//: Reference copy of ~/.claude/settings.json. NOT symlinked: Claude Code writes to settings.json when you change theme or model via /config, and a symlink risks clobbering. Diff this against the live file when you want to reconcile.
//model: Deliberately absent. Managed (organization) settings can pin the model, as opusplan (Opus for planning, claude-sonnet-4-6 for execution) and that wins on restart. A local model key here is dead config that only misleads you about what is running.
//effortLevel: medium for everyday work, as the claude.dev 'spending your effort' post recommends; xhigh globally spent maximum reasoning budget on trivial renames. Verification does not depend on this default: the reviewer, skeptic and judge agents and the review skills pin high, tech-lead and grill-me pin high, mechanical skills pin low. Use /effort mid-session for a hard bug.
//autoCompactWindow: Compact at 400k tokens instead of near the 1M limit: quality drops in long contexts before the window fills. Capped at the model's own window, so it is harmless on smaller models. Applied only when the live file has no value; /autocompact changes it per model.
//attribution: Commits and PRs are attributed to the user alone. Blank strings remove Claude's trailer and PR footer. includeCoAuthoredBy is the deprecated spelling of the same switch; kept false so an older Claude Code build behaves the same. scripts/guard/git.mjs enforces the same rule if this is ever lost.
//hooks: SessionStart prints the branch, spec, task ledger and contract state, and restates the hard rules after a compaction (it fires with source compact; PostCompact cannot add context). PreToolUse(Skill) and UserPromptExpansion log skill use for ai-checkup. UserPromptSubmit logs corrections for memory-distill. PreToolUse(Bash) is the no-credit and draft-only guard. PostToolUse formats edited files from the repo's verification contract, and shrinks a passing test, lint or typecheck run to one line naming a file with the full output (failing runs go to PostToolUseFailure and reach Claude whole). Stop runs the contract and blocks the turn on failure. The format and Stop hooks read the contract through scripts/verify; no hook writes into a target repo. The Stop timeout (1200s) sits above the verifier's own 1080s budget: a hook Claude Code kills at its timeout ends the turn unverified and logs nothing.
